ug-3c01.title: Soil: brown or greyish, not red
ug-3c01.summary: North of a big lake in the west, one of the few places where the dirt is brown or grey instead of red.

ug-7J7B.title: Coverage: the only big village outside the capital
ug-7J7B.summary: One village is the only significant settlement with coverage outside the capital. Smaller villages, lodges and single houses are covered elsewhere.

ug-9T7E.title: Landscape: wooded road, hidden mountains
ug-9T7E.summary: On the southern half of the north road, there are more trees, so the mountains are sometimes hard to see.

ug-9lkl.title: Road: only paved road outside the capital
ug-9lkl.summary: The only paved road with coverage outside the capital. No red tinge, white solid edge lines and a yellow centre line. Power line to the east, hills north.

ug-Aj2o.title: Vehicles: taxi vans with blue blocky pattern
ug-Aj2o.summary: Minibus taxis with a blue blocky pattern on the sides are everywhere in the capital. Useful if the Google car is not visible.

ug-Ipy7.title: Road: small forest road, flat and fairly bright
ug-Ipy7.summary: Second type in the forest park: a smaller road still wide enough for a car. The forest is dense but not very dark, and the land is flat.

ug-KblI.title: Driving side: left
ug-KblI.summary: Traffic drives on the left. Africa is split between left and right, so this helps narrow it down.

ug-Pesx.title: Google car: white, boxy, square mirrors
ug-Pesx.summary: In the capital the car is white and boxy, with square side mirrors. This car exists nowhere else.

ug-R56r.title: Landscape: the driest country coverage, hilly
ug-R56r.summary: West of Lake Victoria, the grass is almost always totally dried out. Bushes and trees look dry too. Hilly but not mountainous.

ug-TAm5.title: Landscape: savannah ringed by mountains
ug-TAm5.summary: In the north-east, a big savannah with mountains in almost every direction. The most recognisable range is to the east.

ug-UyIE.title: Road: tiny dark forest paths
ug-UyIE.summary: Third type in the forest park: narrow forest paths. Fairly dark, with sun shining through here and there.

ug-WEUz.title: Coverage: humid forest paths, drops on lens
ug-WEUz.summary: Two small forest paths running side by side. The forest is very humid and water drops often show on the camera lens.

ug-WIAR.title: Soil: very red, even under the tarmac
ug-WIAR.summary: The soil is deep red. Even paved roads often look slightly red, purple or pink.

ug-YMfL.title: Coverage: open hill, small palms, armed man
ug-YMfL.summary: The eastern path is an open hilly field with small palm-like trees. A man in green holding a rifle walks behind the photographer.

ug-a937.title: Road: very wide dirt road through tropical forest
ug-a937.summary: One of three coverage types in a forest park: a very wide dirt road through dense tropical forest. It is the widest dirt road with coverage outside the capital.

ug-bGih.title: Plants: tall branching cacti like trees
ug-bGih.summary: On top of brown soil, big cacti with many branches growing almost straight up, shaped like trees.

ug-bT3U.title: Landscape: large water-filled craters
ug-bT3U.summary: In the northern coverage, large craters filled with water are common. They are not found anywhere else in the country.

ug-bk8D.title: Google car: boxy car with black front bar
ug-bk8D.summary: Most park coverage uses a car like the capital one, but with a black bar across the front. Sometimes the car is not visible at all.

ug-ceiz.title: Guardrail: low dirt barriers, savannah and bushes
ug-ceiz.summary: Low dirt barriers along the roadside. Savannah to the west, small trees and bushes to the east. No mountains nearby, only a low wide range far west.

ug-dZPP.title: Plants: distinctive palms, far north of a park
ug-dZPP.summary: These palms mean you are very likely in the northern part of a park by the north end of a big lake.

ug-fGj2.title: Soil: forest path climbing east, dark red dirt
ug-fGj2.summary: Near the Kenyan border, the first path runs through forest on a steep slope going up to the east. The dirt is a very dark red.

ug-kNBu.title: Coverage: only the capital
ug-kNBu.summary: Coverage is very limited: mostly the capital and a nearby city, plus a few national parks. Most clues come from those places.

ug-kguf.title: Plate: white front, yellow rear
ug-kguf.summary: White plate on the front of the car, yellow on the back. Plates can be long or tall.

ug-sbJw.title: Landscape: savannah with one wide mountain north
ug-sbJw.summary: On the northern half of the north road, open savannah with a wide mountain to the north.

ug-ugDY.title: Landscape: hilly city
ug-ugDY.summary: The capital is very hilly. It is rare to get a round there without noticeable slopes.

ug-x1Nk.title: Streets: busy, unpaved, walled houses
ug-x1Nk.summary: A busy city with lots of signs, narrow unpaved roads and small one-storey houses. Houses sit behind tall walls, often topped with barbed wire.

ug-xDJj.title: Streets: emptier, greener, more street signs
ug-xDJj.summary: A city south-west of the capital. It feels emptier and greener, with nicer houses and many more street signs.

ug-xDul.title: Streets: rich city centre, black-white curbs
ug-xDul.summary: The city centre has paved roads with black-and-white curbs and many multi-storey buildings. It looks much richer than the rest of the city.
